'You may play Ghostly Visit from your banished zone.' + printed **Blood Debt**. Shadow Action - Attack (Monarch).

ONLY AUTHORED CLAUSE is the play-from-banished permission: the declarative STATIC PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED, spelling copied from SHIPPED chn/rift_bind_blue.json (the card effect_types.py:1113-1119 cites for exactly this wording). Verified engine-read, not resolved, against source this session: play._self_playable_from_banished (play.py:786-793) scans the declared statics for PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED and play.py:883 consults it per banished card when offering plays - so the permission is live while the card sits in the banished zone. It takes no parameters; this card's clause is unconditional, which is why it is expressible at all (a condition-gated variant is a known DSL gap).

BLOOD DEBT NOT AUTHORED: printed_keywords carries BloodDebt - a CR section 8 keyword on the card DB keywords field, implemented engine-side (ability_keywords.blood_debt); re-authoring it would be a defect.

No other clauses in the printed text. The attack itself needs no authored ability: an Action - Attack card is resolved as an attack by the engine when played. No gaps.
